distractors: BINDT runs PCN, not CSWIP.
ASNT runs SNT-TC-1A, not CSWIP.
UKAS accredits TWI CL; it does not run CSWIP.
content.explanation: CSWIP is administered by TWI Certification Ltd.

content.stem: The CSWIP NDT personnel scheme follows the requirements of:
distractors: SNT-TC-1A is the ASNT employer-based document.
API 1104 is a welding acceptance standard, not a personnel scheme.
ISO 9001 is a quality-system standard.
content.explanation: The CSWIP NDT personnel scheme (CSWIP-ISO-NDT-11/93-R) follows the requirements of ISO 9712.

content.stem: CSWIP is accredited by UKAS to:
distractors: ISO 9001 covers quality management, not personnel certification.
17025 covers testing laboratories, not personnel.
API Q1 is a manufacturing quality spec.
content.explanation: TWI Certification Ltd is accredited by UKAS to ISO/IEC 17024 for the CSWIP scheme.

content.stem: CSWIP certification is managed by the:
distractors: UKAS accredits the scheme; it does not manage it.
ASNT has no role in managing CSWIP.
BINDT committees govern PCN, not CSWIP.
content.explanation: CSWIP is managed by the Certification Management Board, which acts as the Governing Board for Certification.

content.stem: In the CSWIP general theory examination, radiographic testing has:
distractors: 30 is the PT and MT general paper count, not RT.
25 is below the CSWIP general paper counts.
20 is below the CSWIP general paper counts.
content.explanation: In the CSWIP general theory examination, radiographic testing has 40 questions, against 30 for PT and MT.

content.stem: In CSWIP, the general theory papers for PT and MT each have:
distractors: 40 is the radiographic general paper count, not PT or MT.
25 is below the CSWIP general paper counts.
20 is below the CSWIP general paper counts.
content.explanation: In CSWIP, the general theory papers for PT and MT each have 30 questions; RT has 40.

content.stem: CSWIP near-vision requires reading Jaeger 1 or Times N4.5 at not less than:
distractors: CSWIP near vision is at 30 cm and checked yearly.
The distance is not less than 30 cm, checked annually.
Near vision is at 30 cm, not a metre.
content.explanation: CSWIP near vision requires reading Jaeger 1 or Times N4.5 at not less than 30 cm in at least one eye, checked within the year.

content.stem: CSWIP colour perception is assessed using:
distractors: Jaeger cards measure near acuity, not colour.
Snellen measures distance acuity, not colour.
That is a vision screener, not the colour test CSWIP names.
content.explanation: CSWIP assesses colour perception with the Ishihara 24-plate test; RT and TOFD holders also take a shades-of-grey test.

content.stem: A CSWIP NDT certificate is valid for:
distractors: CSWIP certificates run for five years.
Ten years spans two cycles, with recertification at the five-year point.
Two years is shorter than the CSWIP validity.
content.explanation: A CSWIP NDT certificate is valid for five years, in line with ISO 9712.

content.stem: For CSWIP Level 3 structured-credit recertification, the points required out of 100 are:
distractors: The requirement is a band of 50 to 70 of the 100 points.
90 is above the CSWIP structured-credit band.
10 is far below the required band.
content.explanation: For CSWIP Level 3 structured-credit recertification, a minimum of 50 and a maximum of 70 of the 100 points is required.

content.stem: A CSWIP supplementary examination may not be attempted within:
distractors: The supplementary cut-off is 30 days, not six months.
The cut-off is 30 days before expiry.
The rule concerns expiry, not issue.
content.explanation: A CSWIP supplementary examination may not be attempted within 30 days of expiry, and success in it does not extend the certificate's life.

content.stem: CSWIP grants Level 3 Basic examination exemptions to holders of:
distractors: Only valid central ASNT Level III earns the stated exemptions.
A Level 2 does not earn the Level 3 Basic exemptions.
A welding inspector qualification is not the basis for exemption.
content.explanation: CSWIP grants Level 3 Basic exemptions to holders of valid centrally-issued ASNT Level III certification.
